_what: Verse selection order for the Hamdam YouTube Short, most recognised first.
_why: The channel's own numbers: 1,126 views on Saadi's Bani Adam and 488 on Khayyam's jug rubai, against 96, 40 and 16 for verses only a reader of the poet would know. Recognition in the first half-second decides reach. This file inverts the old rule: pick the verse by recognition first, then render whichever mood bucket it belongs to. The five pages do not change.
_authorship: Ranked by Claude on 27 August 2026 from the first hemistich of each entry. This is a judgement about what ordinary Persian speakers recognise, not a measurement. Ealia should reorder it freely; the task reads this file and does not re-derive it.

_wine_screen._note: Hard rule 5 excludes wine allegory. The queue's wine/intoxication/tavern tags miss many of the most famous lines, so these ids are excluded by text even though they carry no wine tag. hafez-001 is the opening of the Divan and among the best known lines in Persian; it is disqualified by the rule, not by obscurity.
